photos.title: Oceanfront buildings in the Windy Hill section of North Myrtle Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: Two oceanfront mid-rise buildings in North Myrtle Beach, cut from a photo taken from a plane over the ocean: stacked balconies with railings on every floor, a flat white roof with rooftop equipment, a pool behind the dunes, and a beach house between the buildings. The few people on the beach are too small to recognize.
photos.caption: Balconies with railings, a flat roof and a pool on oceanfront buildings in North Myrtle Beach, seen from a plane.
photos.alt: Two oceanfront mid-rise buildings in North Myrtle Beach with stacked balconies and railings, a flat roof with rooftop equipment and a pool behind the dunes
photos.author: U.S. Geological Survey
photos.credit: Photo: U.S. Geological Survey, public domain. Credit not required; give it anyway.
photos.provenance: U.S. government photo: USGS baseline coastal oblique aerial survey 11CCH03 (Ponte Vedra, Florida, to the South Carolina/North Carolina border), flown 2011-08-24, photographer Karen L.M. Morgan (USGS). Frame 2011_0824_180512d.jpg from https://coastal.er.usgs.gov/data-release/doi-F7N877XX/data/11CCH03_0824_180500.zip; aircraft position 33.788893 N, 78.728317 W (11CCH03-Photolocations.csv; the position of the plane, not of the buildings). Data release: Morgan, K.L.M., 2017, https://doi.org/10.5066/F7N877XX. The same release as the photo on /sell/out-of-state-buyers/ (a different frame).

photos.subject_check: Checked 2026-11-01 by the writer: Horry County parcel layer 24, oceanfront row between about 33.7905 N and 33.7965 N (northwest of the plane, the camera's view direction): almost every oceanfront parcel there is a condo unit parcel (land use 107 or 108, 22 to 136 unit parcels a name, several named HPR); one oceanfront parcel is a single parcel (land use 388). The caption therefore says 'oceanfront buildings', not 'condo buildings', and names no building. The page uses the photo for the parts it shows (flat roofs, balconies, pools), not as the buildings in the listing count. Fix round 3 (2026-11-01): the page photo is now a closer cut of two of those oceanfront buildings; the fixer looked at it at full size: balconies with railings, a flat roof with equipment and a pool are clear. The caption still names no building.
